name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-requests-approvals
title: Requests and Approvals
shortDescription: A React approval inbox backed by a SharePoint list for reviewing and deciding submitted requests.
longDescription: This sample provides a React-based approval inbox that reads request data from a SharePoint list.
Approvers can review submitted requests and record approval decisions and comments directly from the web part.

references.name: Build your first SharePoint client-side web part
references.description: Client-side web parts are client-side components that run in the context of a SharePoint page.
